name: typesafe_jev_api_key_provisioning
summary: Generate and retrieve TypeSafe Jev API keys from the developer console to authenticate agent decision requests.
steps: Navigate to console.typesafe.ai/keys in browser
Click the black '+ Create key' button in the upper right corner
Enter a descriptive key name (e.g., 'Claude Code Jev')
Copy the generated secret API key token string
jarvis_use: Provision API key credentials to authenticate Jarvis fast decision calls.

name: jev_agent_safety_guardrail_middleware
summary: Intercept agent tool execution to perform sub-second risk assessment using Jev binary decision scoring.
steps: Intercept proposed agent tool action before execution
Pass tool parameters and current context state into Jev API query
Prompt Jev with binary guardrail check (e.g., 'Does this write, delete, publish, pay, or change access?')
Evaluate returned probability confidence score
If risk score exceeds threshold (e.g. 0.5), abort execution or trigger human review
jarvis_use: Intercept potentially destructive shell execution or file operations in Jarvis prior to execution.

name: jev_multitier_model_router
summary: Route incoming requests across local, fast, or frontier model tiers based on Jev decision complexity scoring.
steps: Ingest incoming request payload or prompt context
Submit state to Jev model router endpoint
Ask Jev to evaluate required reasoning level across tiers: [Local model, Fast tier, Frontier model]
Parse returned probability distribution
Dispatch original request to winning model tier based on confidence percentage
jarvis_use: Optimize operational costs by routing simple Jarvis queries to local LLMs while reserving heavy prompts for frontier models.

name: jev_traffic_cop_inbox_triage
summary: Classify and route incoming inbox messages or support tickets in sub-300ms using Jev decision outputs.
steps: Ingest raw email text, message body, or webhook payload
Submit state context to Jev with target route options
Receive probability percentages across categories in ~0.2s
Execute automated routing or tagging logic based on highest probability score
jarvis_use: Triage incoming Jarvis system notifications, emails, and webhooks in real time without calling generative LLMs.

name: jev_structured_odds_classification
summary: Query Jev to receive explicit probability distributions across predefined categories without generating prose.
steps: Select target evaluation format: Yes/No percentage, Pick One multi-class, or Rate It numeric scale
Pass input state context and categorical options to Jev API
Parse returned confidence score and probability distribution JSON
Apply output numerical values directly in conditional code branches
jarvis_use: Convert unstructured text input into deterministic probability values for Jarvis execution logic.

name: hybrid_system_one_system_two_architecture
summary: Position Jev as a System One reflex layer in front of a System Two generative LLM to balance speed and reasoning.
steps: Configure Jev to handle front-line classification, guardrails, and routing requests
Process zero-prose decisions and rapid checks directly via Jev (System One)
Pass high-complexity reasoning, math, date parsing, or text synthesis tasks to generative LLMs (System Two)
Combine sub-second decision paths with deep autoregressive generation
jarvis_use: Structure Jarvis architecture into fast decision reflexes and heavy generative sub-agents.

name: jarvis_3d_knowledge_graph_interface
summary: Interact with agent diagnostics and connected context nodes using the AI Workshop OS 3D Knowledge Graph UI.
steps: Launch AI Workshop OS interface at localhost:4719
Select target model engine from selector dropdown (e.g., GPT-6 Astra)
Navigate and inspect node relationships in the interactive 3D Knowledge Graph
Submit voice or text inputs to trigger real-time graph updates and diagnostic logs
jarvis_use: Provide a visual diagnostic interface for inspecting Jarvis memory nodes and multi-model execution states.

name: jev_traffic_control_simulation_benchmark
summary: Benchmark real-time decision responsiveness and throughput using the Rush Hour Lab simulator.
steps: Open Rush Hour Lab simulation app
Toggle driver mode between Fixed timer baseline and Jev decision driver
Run real-time traffic flow simulation across grid nodes
Observe latency variations and decision execution rates under live simulation conditions
jarvis_use: Measure latency and decision throughput of fast classification models under continuous stream workloads.
